body:
`EditorSceneFormatImporterBlend` has an import option prefixed with `gltf/` (not `blender/` like the other options). `ResourceImporterScene` borrows options from all format importers and ends up with two options `gltf/naming_version`. I removed the duplicate when generating the documentation, but it still appears in the editor (because `EditorHelp` generates documentation again after the format importers have been registered).

Is the presence of the `gltf/naming_version` import option in `EditorSceneFormatImporterBlend` a bug? Should it be named `blender/naming_version` or `blender/gltf/naming_version` instead? Or maybe this option shouldn't be declared again?

body:
That seems wrong to me, why do we expose all these in `ResourceImporterScene`? They should be exposed in their respective `EditorSceneFormatImporter` (as also done in this PR), but not here.

Duplicating them here breaks encapsulation as those are defined in modules so if the modules are disabled, this doc will change/be invalid. Likely if new scene format importers are added via thirdparty modules (e.g. USD), this will also impact a core documentation file.

Do you need them here for tooltips or what's the reason to expose them here?

body:
These properties are duplicated here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1eb0374e5f3efa05d8a9914f482b894b5b1f6b9c/editor/import/3d/resource_importer_scene.cpp#L2549-L2551

See also #117446. These properties are **already** listed as undocumented in `EditorHelp`, and the misleading contribution link is displayed in the descriptions. This is because the documentation for `--doctool` and `EditorHelp` is generated under different conditions (in the former, the `EditorNode` is not instantiated and format importers are not registered).

An alternative is to not include these properties in the `ResourceImporterScene` documentation, but also exclude them when generating documentation for `EditorHelp` (mark them with `PROPERTY_USAGE_INTERNAL`?). Furthermore, we need to add a hack so that descriptions from `EditorSceneFormatImporter`s are displayed for properties copied to `ResourceImporterScene`.
